summary_en: Fuji Corporation executed a share buyback of 1,921,500 shares (2.18% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for 9,999,486,000 yen at the closing price of 5,204 yen on November 5, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 on November 6, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Repurchase via Off-Hours Negotiated Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Fuji Corporation executed an off-hours negotiated trade (ToSTNeT-3) to repurchase 1,921,500 shares of its ordinary stock at a fixed price of 5,204 yen per share, the closing price on November 5, 2026. The total consideration was 9,999,486,000 yen, representing 2.18% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The purchase order was placed at 8:45 a.m. on November 6 and was valid only for that trading time window.

This execution is part of the company's Fully Committed Share Repurchase (FCSR) program. The company noted that market conditions could result in the transaction not being completed in full or in part. The treasury stock of 185,699 shares held by the ESOP trust was excluded from the calculation of the share buyback ratio.
